cases.name: human_authoring
cases.situation: A developer wants to create modules, pages, states, and routes interactively.

cases.name: nested_outline
cases.situation: A developer needs to switch between pages owned by several modules without losing hierarchy context.

cases.name: automation
cases.situation: A script needs to validate or update lifecycle status without interaction.

cases.name: external_change
cases.situation: The YAML file changes after a browser snapshot was loaded.

cases.name: auto_save
cases.situation: A developer edits the browser draft and pauses typing.

cases.name: flow_review
cases.situation: A developer wants to inspect page-to-page routes and preview every Figma state across all pages.

cases.name: flow_fullscreen
cases.situation: A developer wants more room to inspect a large page flow without leaving the editor.

cases.name: branching_flow
cases.situation: One page has conditional transitions to several different destination pages.

cases.name: internal_state_flow
cases.situation: A developer models an alert or another conditional visual state inside one page.

cases.name: inline_validation
cases.situation: Validation finds missing or invalid values across several pages and behaviors.

cases.name: compact_behavior_state_cards
cases.situation: A page has many behaviors or visual states and the developer needs to scan and edit them without losing context.

cases.name: terminal_route_destination
cases.situation: A back or dismiss action reveals a known existing page that is not the module entry page.

cases.name: behavior_authoring
cases.situation: A developer needs to specify which page region scrolls, stays fixed, or locks for selected states.

cases.name: custom_behavior_authoring
cases.situation: A page starts a countdown when it appears and changes state or navigates when that countdown finishes.

cases.name: status_change
cases.situation: A page is claimed, completed, failed, blocked, or requeued in the editor.

cases.name: page_type_artifact_preview
cases.situation: A developer titles a page today and chooses whether it is a View or ViewController.

cases.name: start_codex
cases.situation: A user looks for a browser action that starts implementation work.
